name: Ranged Versatility, Improved
body:
Prerequisite(s): Ranged Versatility, extended range infusion wild talent, kineticist 9th.

Benefit(s): By increasing their burn costs by 1, you can apply the extended range or extreme range infusions to your kinetic blasts, regardless of the normal limitations of your archetype.
